message.unbound_world.weapon_nerfed: §eYour weapon's power is suppressed to base level.§r
stage.unbound_world.echoes.summary: The seas grow restless. Depths once calm now hide guardians of ancient treasure.
stage.unbound_world.sculk_dread.summary: Something ancient listens in the deep dark. Every step echoes closer to its wrath.
stage.unbound_world.hellfire.summary: The Nether's fury boils over. Its undying tyrant demands a reckoning.
stage.unbound_world.void_call.summary: Beyond the stars, the End awakens. Its ancient sentinel guards what should not be taken.
stage.unbound_world.apotheosis.summary: The final seal strains against a power beyond mortal reckoning.
boss.unbound_world.elder_guardian.locati: Found in ocean monuments, guarding the depths alongside its guardian kin.
boss.unbound_world.drowned.location: Roams flooded ruins and ocean floors, sometimes wielding a trident.
boss.unbound_world.cow.location: Grazes peacefully in grassy biomes across the Overworld.
boss.unbound_world.pufferfish.location: Drifts through warm ocean waters, puffing up when threatened.
boss.unbound_world.warden.location: Emerges from the deepest sculk shrieker alarms within an Ancient City.
boss.unbound_world.zombie.location: Shambles through the Overworld at night or in dark places.
boss.unbound_world.chicken.location: Wanders grassy plains and forests across the Overworld.
boss.unbound_world.enderman.location: Teleports across the Overworld, End, and Nether, avoiding water.
boss.unbound_world.wither.location: Summoned by placing four Soul Sand or Soul Soil in a T-shape and three Wither Skeleton Skulls on top.
boss.unbound_world.skeleton.location: Patrols dark caves and the surface at night, armed with a bow.
boss.unbound_world.pig.location: Roots through grassy plains and forests across the Overworld.
boss.unbound_world.piglin_brute.location: Guards Bastion Remnants deep within the Nether.
boss.unbound_world.ender_dragon.location: Circles the central obsidian pillars of the End dimension.
boss.unbound_world.shulker.location: Hides within End City towers, camouflaged against the purpur blocks.
boss.unbound_world.sheep.location: Grazes peacefully in grassy biomes across the Overworld.
boss.unbound_world.endermite.location: Rarely spawns when a player uses an Ender Pearl.
boss.unbound_world.wither_skeleton.locat: Stalks the dark fortress halls of the Nether.
boss.unbound_world.spider.location: Climbs walls and lurks in caves during the night.
boss.unbound_world.husk.location: Wanders desert biomes under the scorching sun, immune to burning.
boss.unbound_world.rabbit.location: Hops through plains, deserts, and snowy tundras.
boss.unbound_world.vindicator.location: Guards Woodland Mansions and Pillager Outposts with an axe.
